notes.title: Drones To Release On 11/15
notes.content:
Drones is here - Check out these parts features that are available in the launch release!

Enemies
15 enemies, consisting of 5 different classes and 3 different types!
Read more about the breakdown here.

Gamemodes
Work your way progressively through stages in Wave Mode to unlock harder stages, or try your hand at the endless Survival Mode to see how long you can last!

Achievements
18 Unique Steam achievements to unlock for various different tasks!

Leaderboards
10 different leaderboards to compare your highscores against your friends!

Firepower
3 Different weapon classes to unlock and use, as well as a few different types of grenades to throw - including a vampire grenade which leeches health from your enemies!

Upgrades
Give youself an advantage the next time you play by using money earned from scoring to spend on upgrades for your character. Unlock more weapons, increased damage, faster reloads and more!

Items
Pickup items while playing ranging from overloads which will give you increased damage and firepower, to standard power refills or even find more special items like a cash crate or a keycard!

Maps
5 different maps will be available to play!

notes.title: The Drone Army Breakdown
notes.content:
Want to know what you're up against?
The drone army of the Overseer is comprised of 5 different classed units and 3 different unit types. Here is a breakdown of what to expect going in:

Unit Classes

Thrall Units
These guys are dumb, slow, bottom of the barrel type units. They are rather disposable and pose little to no threat - amounting to nothing more than easy points.

Saboteur Units
Beware of these ones - they'll sneak up on you because they are stealthy and do not appear on your minimap. They tend to attack fast as well, and often times you'll find yourself under siege before you realize they're there.

Standard Units
Being rigid and well built, these units sport a balanced construction. they are the most common class of drone and have all around average skills.

Tank Units
Armored and tough, the tank units are not to be taken lightly. These units are shielded by shield generators throughout the facility. While the generators are active, the tanks take significantly less damage than they do while inactive. Destroying generators is strongly recommended for dealing with these ones.

Boss Units
These are the best the overseer has to offer, and they are definitely difficult to deal with. Bosses boast a large health pool, speedy attacks, and powerful punches. Defeating a boss will reward you handsomely.


Unit Types

Probes
The Overseer's army is mostly comprised of probes. Probes are essentially floating mines that patrol the rooms and corridors of the facility. If you get to close to them, they will become alert - locking onto you and starting a countdown to explosion. You can avoid the explosion by getting far enough away from them or destroying them.

Sentries
These units have more health than their probe counterparts but the trade-off is in their mobility. Sentries are stationary autoturrets which attempt to track your location and will launch grenades toward you. One on one these aren't too challenging, but a few near each other can cause you some issues.

Wardens
The wardens are the best of the best, being the Overseer's generals. These are patrolling beacons which sound alarm on seeing you. All warden effects are active until the warden is defeated.They do not engage in combat directly, but act as an technical unit, capable of many different tasks dependent on their construction:


 Thrall
Causes all force fields to be constantly active. To get through the force fields with the warden thrall is active, you have to be extremely quick after taking one down - as it will immediately power back up.

 Saboteur
Disrupts your navigation system, leaving you blinded without a scanner or minimap so that all units gain the same stealth of the saboteur units.

 Standard
Siphons your power down so that you have less ammunition to fire at enemies, making grenades more useful during their activity.

 Tank
Applies shielding to every unit currently active. Like the tank units, all units will take significantly less damage (including the warden itself) but instead of destroying the generators you must destroy the warden.

 Boss
Commands all active probes to lock onto your position and move toward you. Upon defeat the probes will resume their regular patrol route. Dealing with these guys from a distance as to not activate their alarm is highly recommended.
